title: Faz 0 infrastructure: git baseline, tracked migrations, dependencies, settings, import side effects, test harness, FORMULATION outline
purpose: Make the repository reproducible and testable without changing simulation behaviour. Every later spec depends on this one because it removes import-time side effects in about 20 modules and introduces the pytest harness and the process entry points.
behaviour_change: none (refactor and infrastructure only). Characterization tests pin the current behaviour, including known defects.
work_steps: 0.1 Create branch from 'serial' (proposed name 'refactor/plan-2026-10'), run 'git status', 'git check-ignore -v' on every untracked path, stage everything except abc_log/, abc_logs/ and git-ignored files, commit 'chore: baseline of uncommitted work before PLAN.md fixes'.

0.2 Determine why abmem/migrations/ is ignored: the repository .gitignore has no 'migrations' entry, so check '.git/info/exclude' and 'git config core.excludesFile' with 'git check-ignore -v abmem/migrations/0001_initial.py'. Remove the rule at its source or add '!abmem/migrations/' to .gitignore. Track 0001-0003. Run 'python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run' and record the result. If model and DB differ, stop and report (do not generate a migration in this spec).

0.3 Generate requirements.txt from E:/Anaconda/envs/rlearning with pinned versions for the packages actually imported (torch, Django, django-enumfield, psycopg2 or psycopg2-binary, pandas, openpyxl, numpy, PyYAML, channels and channels-redis while K10 is pending, pytest, pytest-django). Add an installation section to README.md (create README.md if absent).

0.4 settings.py reads SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_HOST, DB_PORT, ALLOWED_HOSTS from environment variables via os.environ with documented defaults only for non-secret values. Add .env.example. Keep .env ignored. A missing SECRET_KEY raises ImproperlyConfigured unless DEBUG is true.

0.5 Remove every sys.path.append(...) and every import-time django.setup(). Create abmem/bootstrap.py with setup_django() and process entry functions. Replace script-style imports in services/algorithms/optimization ('from moabc import MOABC', 'from abc_logger import ABCLogger', 'from hyperparam_optimization import ...') with package imports. Replace DATAPATH and other CWD-relative paths with pathlib paths anchored at settings.BASE_DIR.
0.6 Add pytest.ini, conftest.py, tests/ package, tests/factories.py (plain builder functions, no new dependency) and characterization tests.

0.7 Create .claude/context/FORMULATION.md from ~/.claude/templates/FORMULATION.md with only the section outline of ARCHITECTURE.md section 10. No equations or values are written without explicit user approval.

modify: web_project/asgi.py (remove duplicate DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE line ordering issue only)
manage.py (verify it is the only setup point for CLI)
abmem/services/starter/starter_service.py (remove django.setup at line 17, use bootstrap.run_simulation_process as Process target with spawn context, pass simulation id)

public_interfaces.description: Idempotent. Sets DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE via os.environ.setdefault and calls django.setup() once per process. Safe to call twice.

Top-level picklable Process target. Calls setup_django(), then imports abmem.services.simulation.simulation_service lazily and runs the simulation with the given id. Must not import abmem.models at module import time.
Pool initializer: setup_django(), torch.set_num_threads(1), django.db.connections.close_all(). Used by hpo.service.

Unchanged name and return value (simulation id). For non-proxy simulations closes DB connections and starts multiprocessing.get_context('spawn').Process(target=bootstrap.run_simulation_process, args=(simulation.id,)). Proxy simulations are not started (current behaviour).
Absolute path to abmem/data resolved from Path(__file__). All file readers use it.

invariants: No module under abmem/ calls sys.path.append or django.setup() at import time (enforced by tests/test_bootstrap.py scanning source with ast).
Importing abmem.services.simulation.simulation_service inside a configured Django process has no side effect besides module definitions.
No secret value is present in tracked files after 0.4.
Simulation behaviour is byte-identical to the baseline commit for a fixed seed (characterization tests).
edge_cases: setup_django called twice in one process: second call is a no-op.
Missing environment variables: non-secret defaults apply, missing SECRET_KEY with DEBUG false raises ImproperlyConfigured.
Spawned child on Windows: target is module-level function in a module without ORM imports at top level.
Paths: DATA_DIR resolves correctly when the CWD is not the repository root (test changes CWD to a temp dir).
Test database: pytest-django creates 'test_abmem' on PostgreSQL. If the DB role lacks CREATEDB, tests fail with a clear message documented in README.
test_plan: tests/test_bootstrap.py: AST scan asserts no sys.path.append and no top-level django.setup() call in abmem/**/*.py. setup_django idempotence.

tests/characterization/test_clearing_current.py: current marketClearing on (a) distinct prices example from analiz.md 3.5 (A=400@50, B=300@70, C=500@90, D=200@120, D=1000 -> 400/300/300/0, PTF=90), (b) the B4 example (A=100, B=10 same price, D=60) asserting the CURRENT result (B=10, A=20, 30 MWh accepted) with marker 'characterization_changes_in_1_7', (c) supply shortfall, (d) zero demand.
tests/characterization/test_budget_current.py: budgetCalculation accepted and rejected cases with explicit costs.
tests/characterization/test_period_creation_current.py: createPeriod uses marketData['demand'][currentPeriod] (current indexing, pinned until 1.7).
Manual: 'python manage.py check' passes, 'python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run' result recorded in the commit message.
acceptance_criteria: pytest runs green on the rlearning environment.
git ls-files shows the three migrations and requirements.txt.
settings.py contains no literal secret or password.
